newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices fall on low demand, sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices fall on low demand, sentiment.

text.p: Indian sugar prices fell on Friday on low demand and subdued sentiment amidst limited activity, dealers said.
"Inflows too were low as mill owners had already unloaded most of the sugar out of their free sale quota for the current month," one dealer said.
Newspaper reports that the Indian government would deregulate exports, now monopolised by a private agency set up by the sugar milling industry, failed to cheer the market.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by five rupees to 1,350/1,390 rupees per quintal while M-30 fell by 15 to 1,375/1,426 rupees.
